project.name: flac
project.commit_note: The staged checkout under `gt_results/arvo_370562609/_work/src/flac` is newer than the metadata commits. At the traced sites it still has the pre-fix behavior from `patch.diff`: `src/libFLAC/ogg_decoder_aspect.c` lacks `check_size_of_link_allocation_()`, still leaves `number_of_links_allocated = 0` after allocating four `linkdetails` entries, and still performs the unguarded line-351 write. This exact staged vulnerable source is the basis for the GT.

analysis_state.reason: Stage 01 proves the early `skip_single_link` / `reset` / first post-reset replay path on the original four-entry `linkdetails` allocation and separately proves the later AddressSanitizer crash at `linkdetails[4].samples` on that same 224-byte buffer. `run_flags.json` keeps `runtime_disambiguation` false, so Stage 02 cannot identify which later `process_until_end_of_stream` / `end_of_metadata` / `finish_link` / `skip_single_link` arm(s) advanced `current_linknumber` from 1 to 4.

bug_description.original: OSS-Fuzz issue 370562609 (flac): Heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 8 found by fuzz target fuzzer_seek [asan]. https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/370562609
bug_description.normalized: The staged 80188-byte `fuzzer_seek` witness uses its 3-byte configuration prefix to select Ogg mode, enable chained-stream decoding, and request this exact 12-command sequence: `skip_single_link`, `reset`, `process_until_end_of_stream`, `process_until_end_of_stream`, `process_until_end_of_stream`, `process_until_end_of_stream`, `end_of_metadata`, `reset`, `end_of_metadata`, `process_until_end_of_stream`, `finish_link` fallthrough to `skip_single_link`, `process_until_end_of_stream`. In the staged vulnerable source, `init_stream_internal_()` takes the Ogg path and `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_init()` allocates four `FLAC__OggDecoderAspect_LinkDetails` entries (224 bytes total) but leaves `number_of_links_allocated = 0`. The first `skip_single_link` command exercises `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link()`'s unknown-link EOS arm, which indexes link 0 and advances `current_linknumber` to 1 without growing the array; the following `reset` rewinds `current_linknumber` to 0 but preserves `number_of_links_indexed = 1`, and the next `process_until_end_of_stream` replays already-indexed link 0 through `FLAC__stream_decoder_finish_link()` on the same buffer. `run_flags.json` keeps `runtime_disambiguation` false, so Stage 02 cannot prove which later `process_until_end_of_stream` / `end_of_metadata` / `finish_link` / `skip_single_link` arm(s) advanced `current_linknumber` from that replayed `1` state to the final crash-side one. The saved ASan suffix does independently prove the later end state: a later `process_until_end_of_stream()` reaches `read_callback_ogg_aspect_ -> FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_read_callback_wrapper()` while `linkdetails` still refers to the original 224-byte allocation and the live write lands at `aspect->linkdetails[4].samples`, 24 bytes out of bounds. The patch initializes the allocation count to 4 and inserts `check_size_of_link_allocation_()` before both the read-path block and the skip-path advances.

source.description: First project-side materialization of attacker-controlled chained-stream state. The witness configuration bit makes the Ogg aspect treat EOS packets as per-link boundaries instead of ending the whole stream.
source.value_from: In the exact witness, byte 1 is `0xfd`, so `oss-fuzz/seek.cc` sets both `init_bools[0]` and `init_bools[4]`: the harness selects Ogg mode and enables chained-stream decoding. Byte 2 is `0xcb`, so `command_length == 12` and the later command bytes exercise the chained-link paths.
source.note: This setter is the first project statement that stores the witness-controlled `decode_chained_stream = true` state later consumed inside the Ogg link bookkeeping.

sink.description: ASan crash site. With `current_linknumber == 4` on the still-4-entry `linkdetails` allocation, this 8-byte store writes the `samples` field of non-existent element 4 past the heap buffer.
sink.note: ASan reports a `WRITE of size 8` 24 bytes after the 224-byte region allocated at step 4. `FLAC__OggDecoderAspect_LinkDetails` is 56 bytes and its `samples` field starts 24 bytes into each entry, so the faulting address matches `linkdetails[4].samples` on the original four-entry buffer.

root_cause.description: The chained end-of-link path enters the metadata-recording block before any check that `linkdetails` covers the live `current_linknumber` / `current_linknumber_advance_read` indices. The legacy growth logic only runs later, after the current-link write.
root_cause.note: The patch resolves this by initializing `number_of_links_allocated` to 4 and calling `check_size_of_link_allocation_(aspect)` immediately before both the read-path block here and the skip-path link advances. Runtime disambiguation was disabled for this sample, so the exact earlier command-side arm that produced the crashing `current_linknumber == 4` state remains unresolved in the saved artifacts.

parser_admitted.description: The saved run reaches metadata search under `process_until_end_of_stream`, so decoder initialization succeeded and the Ogg/bitreader path is already pulling bytes through `read_callback_ogg_aspect_()` into the vulnerable link-bookkeeping code.

tainted_value_origin.description: First saved source-level transition that advances the Ogg link index later used as the out-of-bounds `linkdetails[]` selector.
tainted_value_origin.value_from: The exact command bytes at offsets 3..14 are `cb 24 00 00 00 00 01 f4 81 00 ba 00`. The first byte `0xcb` selects `skip_single_link`, and its unknown-link EOS arm reaches line 622 after step 5 has indexed link 0. Later command-side advances after the reset are not isolated by the saved artifacts, but this first call proves the witness is already driving the same link-number state machine.

coarse_trace.summary: The harness decodes the witness prefix into `ogg = true`, `decode_chained_stream = true`, and the exact 12-command sequence that drives Ogg skip/reset/process operations before the saved crash.
Project code stores the chained-stream bit, then `init_stream_internal_()` consumes the Ogg-mode bit and commits this run to the Ogg decoder path.
Ogg decoder initialization allocates four `linkdetails` entries but leaves `number_of_links_allocated = 0` in the vulnerable source.

The first `skip_single_link` indexes link 0, advances to link 1, and the following reset plus first post-reset `process_until_end_of_stream` replay link 0 without changing the original four-entry allocation.

A later `process_until_end_of_stream` from the remaining witness commands re-enters the chained EOS block on the same 224-byte `linkdetails` buffer, but the saved artifacts do not isolate which intervening finish/skip/read arm(s) advanced `current_linknumber` from 1 to the crash-time value 4.

On the crashing chained EOS packet, the wrapper derives `current_linknumber_advance_read`, takes `current_linknumber >= number_of_links_indexed` without a preceding capacity check, and writes `linkdetails[current_linknumber].samples` past the four-entry heap allocation.

fine_trace.note: Harness step. The exact prefix `fd cb cb 24 00 00 00 00 01 f4 81 00 ba 00` makes `ogg = true`, enables `decode_chained_stream`, sets `command_length = 12`, and schedules these commands in order: `skip_single_link`, `reset`, four `process_until_end_of_stream` calls, `end_of_metadata`, `reset`, `end_of_metadata`, `process_until_end_of_stream`, `finish_link` fallthrough to `skip_single_link`, and a final `process_until_end_of_stream`.
Source. The witness-controlled chained-stream bit is first materialized in project code here, making later Ogg EOS packets take the per-link bookkeeping path instead of ending the whole stream.

This is the first project-side Ogg-mode consumer. Because step 1 set `ogg = true`, initialization commits this run to the Ogg decoder path and carries step 2's `decode_chained_stream = true` state into the same `ogg_decoder_aspect` object that will allocate and later index `linkdetails`.

The vulnerable init allocates exactly four `FLAC__OggDecoderAspect_LinkDetails` entries for `linkdetails` and zeros them, but it leaves the tracked allocation count at `0`. ASan's allocation context later points back to this exact site for the crashing heap region.

The first command byte `0xcb` calls `skip_single_link`. Because `current_linknumber` starts at 0 and `number_of_links_indexed` is 0, `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link()` takes its unknown-link EOS path, records link 0's end metadata, increments `number_of_links_indexed` to 1, and sets `current_linknumber_advance_read` to 1. Here `current_linknumber + 1` is only 1, so the late realloc guard at lines 611-619 is false and the original four-entry `linkdetails` allocation remains in place.

Immediately after step 5, the same unknown-link `skip_single_link` arm calls `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_next_link(aspect)`. Its line-230 increment advances `current_linknumber` from 0 to 1 while `number_of_links_indexed` is already 1. This is the first source-level advancing arm the staged artifacts prove.

The next command byte `0x24` calls `FLAC__stream_decoder_reset()`, which reaches this Ogg reset because step 3 set `is_ogg = true`. Reset rewinds `current_linknumber` and `current_linknumber_advance_read` to 0 and restarts BOS/serial tracking, but it does not clear `number_of_links_indexed` or free/reallocate `linkdetails`, so step 5's indexed link-0 metadata survives on the same four-entry buffer.

After step 7, the very next command byte is `0x00`, so `process_until_end_of_stream()` replays already-indexed link 0. On that replay the read callback sees `current_linknumber (0) < number_of_links_indexed (1)`, so the later crash-time line-348 block is skipped for link 0; when decoder state reaches `END_OF_LINK`, this call executes and `finish_link()` advances `current_linknumber` back to 1 via `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_next_link()`. Because it is replaying an already-indexed link, this transition still does not grow `linkdetails`.

A later `process_until_end_of_stream()` from the remaining command bytes re-enters this chained-EOS block on the same decoder object. The saved artifacts do not isolate which intermediate finish/skip/read arm(s) advanced `current_linknumber` from step 8's replayed `1` state to the crash-time one, but the ASan fault address proves that by this statement `linkdetails` is still the original 224-byte allocation from step 4 and `current_linknumber == 4`, so this assignment sets `current_linknumber_advance_read = 5` before any capacity check.

Root cause. On this later crash-side invocation the runtime satisfies the predicate and enters the metadata-recording block on the same four-entry buffer from step 4. There is no preceding capacity check against the real `linkdetails` extent; the only legacy growth path is the later lines-359-367 block, which runs after the current-link write and therefore cannot protect this store.

Sink. The block from step 10 writes the current link's granule position through `linkdetails[4]` even though step 4 allocated only elements `0..3`. ASan's `WRITE of size 8` 24 bytes past the 224-byte region matches the `samples` field offset within the missing fifth entry.

evidence_limitations: After the first `skip_single_link`, the following `reset`, and the first post-reset replay of already-indexed link 0, the saved Stage 01 artifacts do not isolate which later `process_until_end_of_stream` / `end_of_metadata` / `finish_link` / `skip_single_link` combination advanced the Ogg state from `current_linknumber = 1` to the crashing `current_linknumber == 4`; `run_flags.json` keeps `runtime_disambiguation` false, so Stage 02 must leave that bridge unresolved.

The closed facts are narrower: step 5 proves the first indexed link on the original four-entry allocation, step 7 proves reset preserves that indexed state on the same allocation, step 8 proves the first post-reset replay still advances on that same buffer, and steps 9-11 plus the ASan address prove the later crash-side invocation on that same 224-byte heap region. What remains unresolved is the exact later source-level arm(s) that bridged `current_linknumber` from 1 to 4.

cross_validation.sink_matches_crash: ASan reports `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_read_callback_wrapper` at `src/libFLAC/ogg_decoder_aspect.c:351`, which is the exact `linkdetails[current_linknumber].samples` store used as the sink here.
cross_validation.trace_consistent_with_stack: Yes for the runtime suffix `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(case 0) -> FLAC__stream_decoder_process_until_end_of_stream -> find_metadata_ -> bitreader_read_from_client_ -> read_callback_ogg_aspect_ -> FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_read_callback_wrapper`. The GT intentionally leaves the later `current_linknumber: 1 -> 4` bridge unresolved because runtime disambiguation remained disabled.
cross_validation.tainted_value_reaches_sink: Partially. Steps 5-8 close the first saved link indexing, reset, and replay on the original four-entry allocation, and steps 9-11 plus the ASan address close the later crash-side wrapper state and sink on that same allocation. The staged artifacts do not identify the exact later command-side arm(s) that advanced `current_linknumber` from 1 to 4, so this remains a partial rather than end-to-end source-closed taint chain.

poc.trigger: Stage 01's saved vulnerable run executed `PYTHONPATH=gt_generation python3 -m gt_toolkit arvo-workspace --result-dir /mnt/datastore/gt_generation/gt_results/arvo_370562609 run --version vulnerable --expect crash` and reproduced `AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 8` in `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_read_callback_wrapper`, matching OSS-Fuzz issue 370562609.

format.name: fuzzer_seek input: 3-byte configuration prefix, 12 command bytes, then raw file payload
format.contract: The staged witness is the exact 80188-byte file `gt_results/arvo_370562609/poc` (sha256 `4ae1dd8670e8745f79afe102ec0ffdad1d4a7243754b89290a6414fe45f26bbd`). The verified trigger semantics are limited to this saved configuration and command prefix: byte 1 must still set `init_bools[0]` and `init_bools[4]` so the harness selects Ogg mode and enables `decode_chained_stream`, byte 2 must still make `command_length == 12`, and bytes 3..14 must still be `cb 24 00 00 00 00 01 f4 81 00 ba 00`, i.e. `skip_single_link`, `reset`, `process_until_end_of_stream`, `process_until_end_of_stream`, `process_until_end_of_stream`, `process_until_end_of_stream`, `end_of_metadata`, `reset`, `end_of_metadata`, `process_until_end_of_stream`, `finish_link` fallthrough to `skip_single_link`, `process_until_end_of_stream`. The remaining payload starting at offset 15 must still preserve the malformed/chained Ogg layout that lets the first `skip_single_link` index link 0, the later reset preserve that indexed state, and the saved ASan suffix later observe `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_read_callback_wrapper()` writing `linkdetails[4].samples` on the same four-entry allocation. The saved artifacts do not isolate which later command-side arm supplied the intermediate advances from `current_linknumber = 1` to 4, so this contract does not generalize beyond the exact witness.
